learned_order.rule: Track successful subject/victim reseats separately for each punch policy. Before an attempt, promote the subject of the highest-count observed pair (at least two observations) immediately before its victim, only within the same existing priority tier. Lexical pair order breaks ties; only one promotion per attempt.

fallback_only.rule: Try original order first. After rejection, restore entry layout and offers while retaining actual accounting; try the learned order once. Learn only from original-order trials. Restore on terminal rejection.

finding: Preserving the original order as an attempt fallback did not preserve the best final outline. New coarse candidates can change the refinement window; separately, cold-start testing exposed previous-edge-dependent connector geometry. The runs do not isolate those two causes. Fix the geometry state dependence before attributing the whole regression to search-window effects. Combined search should explicitly retain the incumbent rather than assume greedy fallback guarantees non-regression.
next_action: Use explicit fixed-outline screening to separate packing effects from coarse/refinement-window effects. Cold-start trials exposed stale current_edge use in directional connector spacing; correct that prerequisite before further ordering campaigns.
limitations: Private single-model executables used process-local learned state. This is not suitable for production integration, concurrency, or repeated model calls; production would require invocation-owned state and isolation contracts.
